description: Search the UICapsule catalog by what a component does or looks like. An empty query lists everything, newest first. Hosts that render MCP Apps show the results as a browsable gallery.

limit.description: Most results to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

query.description: Free text describing what the component does or looks like, e.g. "rotary dial" or "ios volume slider". Each word is matched against names, slugs, tags and descriptions, and results rank by how many words match; a component matching none is left out. Omit it to list components newest first.

tags.description: Only return components that carry every one of these tags. Kind tags: effects, controls, cards-grids, navigation, data, pages, design-systems. Style tags: minimal, geometric, skeuomorphism, pixel-art, colorful, cyberpunk, silly.

name: search_components
title: Search components
